## Professional Summary
Full-Stack Web Developer based in Nur-Sultan (Astana), Kazakhstan, with a UX/design background and expertise in modern web technologies and content management systems. Specialized in creating responsive, user-friendly websites and applications.

**Available for freelance work.** Open to new clients and projects — building fast, scalable websites and web apps for startups and businesses using WordPress, WooCommerce, React, and Next.js. Get in touch via any of the contact links below.

## Technical Skills
- **Frontend**: ReactJS, NextJS, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
- **Backend**: Node.js, PHP
- **CMS & E-commerce**: WordPress, WooCommerce
- **Design & Prototyping**: Figma
- **Version Control**: Git
